 J U D G M E N T
This writ petition is filed by the petitioner seeking to issue a direction to the Travancore Devaswom Board to award the petitioner the contract for supply of jaggery powder at Sabarimala.
According to the petitioner, the petitioner is the lowest tenderer.
It is pointed out that the rate quoted by the petitioner is lower than that of the second respondent by 10 paise per kilogram.

2. Learned Standing Counsel for the Board submitted that going by the conditions prescribed in the tender notification, only a manufacturer is entitled to submit a tender and the petitioner being not a manufacturer cannot be awarded the contract.

It is also submitted that as far as the credentials of the second respondent are concerned, due enquiries have been made and their tender has been Kerala Stateco-Operative Marketing ... vs Travancore Devaswom Board on 1 November, 2013 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187062486/
2 accepted.
3. Evidently not being a manufacturer, the petitioner will not be entitled to submit the tender.

sentences.text: Apart from that, condition No.3 of the tender conditions will show that prosecution under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 may be initiated, if there is violation of the provisions of the Act apart from the Regulation.

The petitioner not being a manufacturer, prima facie, the first respondent may not be able to proceed with against the petitioner, if subsequently any violations with regard to the provisions of the Act are found out.
In that view of the matter also, this Court will not be justified in entertaining this writ petition.

Sd/-

opennyai_summary.facts:

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
Apart from that, condition No.3 of the tender conditions will show that prosecution under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 may be initiated, if there is violation of the provisions of the Act apart from the Regulation.
The petitioner not being a manufacturer, prima facie, the first respondent may not be able to proceed with against the petitioner, if subsequently any violations with regard to the provisions of the Act are found out.

In that view of the matter also, this Court will not be justified in entertaining this writ petition.
